beds.note: Hardy Latour-Marliac water lily, pale pink (Monet's supplier from 1894). Plants L1, L3, L6, L8, L10 of the sheet's §7; L1 and L6 flowering. Each plant a colony of round(2 + 8 × reach) pads out to its reach, pads 0.10–0.22 radius; held inside the water's edge and clear of the shelves (|x| ≤ 3.12).
Hardy Latour-Marliac water lily, white with a blush at the tips. Plants L2, L4, L5, L7, L9 of §7; L4 and L9 flowering. Colonies as the pink.

Clumps at (−3.50, −0.60) and (−3.47, +0.62), 2 flowers each, on the west shelf; as the east. The golden iris stands on the coping just beyond them at (−4.15, 0).
Tufts at (+3.74, +0.04), (+3.33, −0.92), (+3.33, +0.93): 34–46 arching blades 0.32–0.55 long, 3–5 culms 0.30–0.44 tall with three brown spikes.
